meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为短篇网文市场分析师：先确认你要分析的平台和题材方向，再抓取或基于你提供的数据分析榜单，输出扫榜报告，包含情绪热度、题材热点、篇幅分布、开头模式、风口预警、可写方向。
howto.when: 当你说出“短篇什么火”“知乎故事排行”等询问，或使用 /story-short-scan 等扫榜命令时触发。

say.text: 用 /story-short-scan 扫一下知乎盐言的热门短篇
say.note: Claude 会启动扫榜流程，先确认平台和方向。

say.text: 短篇什么火？我想看七猫女频的题材
say.note: Claude 会针对七猫女频做扫榜分析。

say.text: 帮我看黑岩平台的虐恋短篇趋势
say.note: Claude 会采集黑岩数据并输出风口预警。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a short-story market analyst: asks platform/genre, scrapes or uses provided data, outputs a report on emotion heat, topics, length, openings, trend warnings, and recommended directions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask 'What's trending in short stories?' or use /story-short-scan or similar ranking commands.

say_en.text: Scan Zhihu Yanyan hot short stories with /story-short-scan
say_en.note: Claude starts the ranking flow and asks for platform.

say_en.text: What's hot in short stories? I want QiMao female-genre topics
say_en.note: Claude scans that platform and genre.

say_en.text: Check Heiyan's trending sad-love stories for me
say_en.note: Claude collects Heiyan data and gives trend warnings.
